task: Knowledge-based visual question answering with multimodal RAG
problem: Retrieved contextual knowledge is often not aligned with an LVLM's parametric knowledge; even with ground-truth context LLaVA keeps relying on parametric memory, producing knowledge conflicts and unreliable answers.
architecture: KCM: plug-and-play modification of the LVLM with (i) attention adjustment that up-weights 'contextual' heads (heads attending more to context than to image tokens), (ii) pruning of knowledge-centric neurons that encode coarse parametric knowledge, (iii) context-enhanced logits injected into the final prediction, and (iv) entropy-based weighting of contextual vs parametric logits.
retriever: CLIP-ViT-L/14-336 vision encoder; top-1 retrieved item appended as context
knowledge_source: Wikipedia dump with associated images (InfoSeek knowledge base)

datasets.name: InfoSeek
datasets.details: entity-centric multi-choice VQA; also free-form Human and Validation splits

key_results: LLaVA-1.5: InfoSeek accuracy 58.67 vs 51.97 (regular) and 53.87 (VCD, best baseline); ViQuAE 57.80 vs 53.32 (regular).
LLaVA-1.5 on OK-VQA 60.90 vs 46.17 (regular) and 57.80 (VCD); E-VQA 29.95 vs 29.24 (Entropy decoding).
Average improvement of 6.4% over regular decoding on the multi-choice datasets across four LVLMs.
With ground-truth context, accuracy rises from 65.5 to 71.2 and memorization ratio drops from 46.9 to 39.7.
strengths: Training-free and plug-and-play; consistent gains on four different LVLMs and seven datasets.
Diagnoses the conflict with memorization/context ratios before proposing a fix; ablation of each of the four components.

limitations.text: Requires white-box access to attention heads, neurons and logits, so it cannot be applied to API-only LVLMs.
Only the top-1 retrieved item is used and all LVLMs are 7B models; gains on E-VQA over the best baseline are small (29.95 vs 29.24).

notes: Results averaged over three runs with standard deviations.
title: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Large Vision Language Models via Knowledge Conflict Mitigation
